messages.plaintextBody:
Priya,

For the board meeting on 10 December, the directors need to approve entry into the Patent Licence Agreement and side letter (final economics: £1.25m upfront, 5.0% royalty, £3m cap, EEA/UK/CH). I'll send draft minutes and the completion checklist separately. Could you confirm the directors attending and arrange e-signature once approved?

Elena

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
